## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem, what changes for a user, and why this approach fits. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and device testing, or explain why they do not apply. Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Limits or follow-up

Describe known risks, compatibility considerations, or unfinished work. Mark the PR as a draft if it is not ready for review.

## Before submitting

- [ ] The change is focused and targets `master`.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for credentials, signing keys, and personal data.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] I described the checks I ran and their results.
